lead.owner: The installation owner: manages users, integrations and settings.
lead.member: Can search, browse the library and send downloads.

refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing your profile as last loaded.

password.title: Password
password.description: There is no email reset, so keep it somewhere safe.
password.note: Your other devices are signed out. This one stays signed in. Your access tokens keep working.
password.tooShort: A password is at least 8 characters.
password.tooLong: A password is at most 128 characters.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out; this one stays signed in. Your access tokens keep working.

accessTokens.title: Access tokens
accessTokens.description: A token lets a script or an AI assistant use the app as you, without your password. It reads what you can read, and with “Read and download” access it also sends downloads.
accessTokens.empty: No access tokens yet. Click Create token to give a script or an AI assistant one of its own.
accessTokens.loadFailed: Could not load your access tokens.
accessTokens.refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing your access tokens as last loaded.
accessTokens.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the token. Reload the page and try again.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revokeConfirm.message: Scripts and AI assistants that use {{name}} are refused from now on. This can't be undone: to let them in again, create a new token.

dialog.title: Create an access token
dialog.description: The token acts as you. Its secret is shown once, right after you create it.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHint: What uses it, such as “Claude on the laptop”.

accessHint.ReadOnly: Reads the library, searches, jobs, duplicates and recommendations.
accessHint.ReadAndDownload: Also sends downloads (Keep both), cancels following and marks Not interested.

dialog.lifetimeHint: After that the token stops working. You can revoke it here at any time.

secret.title: Your new access token
secret.description: “{{name}}” is ready. Keep it like a password: anyone who has it can use the app as you.
secret.label: Token
secret.warning: Copy it now: it won't be shown again.
secret.copyFailed: Select the token and press Ctrl+C.
secret.example: A script sends it in the Authorization header, for example:

assistant.title: Connect an AI assistant
assistant.readOnly: This token is read only: the assistant reads what you can, but can't send downloads, cancel following or mark Not interested.

claudeCode.label: Claude Code
claudeCode.hint: Run it once in a terminal; Claude Code then has the app in all your projects.
claudeCode.command: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user mam {{origin}}/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}"
claudeCode.copyFailed: Select the command and press Ctrl+C.

claudeDesktop.label: Claude Desktop
claudeDesktop.hint: Paste it into claude_desktop_config.json (into its mcpServers, if it has one already), then restart Claude Desktop. It needs Node.js 18 or later.
claudeDesktop.copyFailed: Select the configuration and press Ctrl+C.

language.title: Language
language.description: Saved with your account, so it follows you to other browsers and devices. Before you sign in, the browser's language is used.
language.label: Language

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.description: The lists the Recommendations page shows you, and how often the app may ask the release sources about them.
recommendations.tabsHint: A switched-off tab is hidden, and its works are never searched for you.
recommendations.limitHint: How many release-source searches the app may run for your lists in 24 hours; 0 runs none.
recommendations.limitInvalid: The daily search limit is a whole number from 0 to 500.
recommendations.failed: Could not save your recommendation settings.
recommendations.loadFailed: Could not load your recommendation settings.
recommendations.refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing your recommendation settings as last loaded.

session.title: Session
session.description: A session lasts 30 days from its last use. This one ends {{date}} unless you use the app again.
